text: Open your terminal and type “claude”. This is a real Claude session — everything you're about to see is live.
Step 1 — Ask in plain English for a reusable /briefing command. Claude writes it and saves it to .claude/commands.
Restart Claude — custom commands are loaded at startup.
Step 2 — Run /briefing. Claude reads your calendar, to-dos and inbox, and delivers your morning briefing.
Step 3 — Ask Claude to write the schedule: every weekday at 9am, the briefing arrives automatically.
That's it — a daily morning briefing in Claude, built in one short conversation.
